answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, burned when the recruit misbehaves. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pearl of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the tide is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
